issues.title: Lesson videos keep loading and do not play
issues.problem_statement: Some of the customer's students say the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones; the customer hopes it gets sorted out.

items.description: Customer reported that some students say the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and said this was the third time they had raised it.
evidence: Some of my students say the lesson videos just keep loading and never play.
this is the third time I'm raising it

items.description: Support opened the lesson link the customer shared on a desktop in Chrome, in Safari and on a phone; the video played each time, so support could not reproduce the problem from its side.
evidence: I've opened it on my desktop in Chrome and the video plays fine.
It plays on Safari and on my phone too.
So I cannot reproduce the problem from my side.

items.description: Support will raise the issue with the technical team and get back to the customer; support said it could not give a timeline at that point.
evidence: I'll raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
I can't give you a timeline right now

items.description: Customer will ask one of their students to record a short screen recording showing the video loading and send it to support; support asked for it to come along with the lesson link.
evidence: Okay, I'll ask one of the students to record it and send it to you.
What would help is a short screen recording from one affected student, showing the video loading, along with the lesson link.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear next steps; the issue remains unresolved.
